mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.5% signals economic weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days via reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through synchronized demand-supply momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when INDPRO and HOUST both exceed 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) erodes real corporate profits and triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in inflationary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates increasing consumer spending capacity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through higher retail demand and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when PAYEMS increases >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 800,000 units signal real estate market weakness that reduces consumer wealth and confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances (HOUST < 800), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicate accommodative policy supporting strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak industrial activity (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate investment and earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in contractionary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
